Noor - thanks, helpful. High level cost options and tradeoffs (clean numbers for your 200M tokens example):

Assumptions for the calc below: 200M tokens/month total; payments = 12% (~24M tokens).

1) Hosted (standard, lowest lift)
- Pricing: $30 / 1M tokens (baseline)
- Streaming add-on for lower tail latency: +20% on tokens routed via streaming (we charge for tokens processed via streaming pipeline due to persistent connections + throughput guarantees)
- Estimated cost @200M: 200 * $30 = $6,000 / month. If you route payments (24M tokens) through streaming and others via standard generation, approximate blended cost = (24*$36 + 176*$30) = $7,104 / month.
- Latency: p95 typically 300-600ms depending on load/batching; streaming reduces payments p95 to ~200-300ms in most cases.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity commit - recommended for predictable unit economics at scale)
- Pricing: $18 / 1M tokens (committed price) with a monthly reserved capacity contract.
- Autoscaling/burst: optional; bursts billed at a premium.
- Estimated cost @200M: 200 * $18 = $3,600 / month. If you add an SLA-backed latency premium for payments tier (+15% for tighter p95), blended = ~$4,140 / month.
- Latency: p95 ~200-350ms with right instance sizing and smaller batching for payments; batching gives best throughput for bulk flows.

3) Private / VPC (negotiated enterprise pricing)
- Pricing: typically negotiated; expect near-dedicated economics after fixed fees. Recommended if you need full control and KMS/HSM integrations.

Key tradeoffs (latency vs cost)
- Batching: increases throughput and reduces $/1M tokens (we've seen 20-35% savings) but adds tail latency. For bulk support flows, larger batching is recommended.
- Streaming: reduces tail latency for targeted flows (payments) but increases per-token cost for routed traffic. Best practice: route only latency-sensitive flows through streaming and batch the rest.
- SLO-driven pricing: we can offer a commit with tiered SLA: base commit at $18/M; premium tier for guaranteed p95 <300ms on selected routes at +15% on those tokens. This aligns unit cost with SLO requirements.

Quick cost examples (rounded):
- Hosted mixed (payments streaming): ~$7.1k/mo
- Dedicated committed: ~$3.6k/mo (base) or ~$4.1k with payments SLA premium

- If you confirm payment flow % and the Q4 target, Rishi and I will prep a committed pricing proposal (3/6/12 month term options) and a deck for procurement.

I'll attach the calc (pricing_calc_200M_tokens.xlsx) - sending now.

Quick engineering note - feasibility and recommended config: 

- Dedicated instances with tuned batching (small max batch for payments route) + prefix/KV caching should reliably hit p95 ~250-300ms for a majority of traffic on modern GPUs (A100 / H100 class or equivalent).
- Streaming: use streaming for the critical payments path to reduce tail latency and keep token generation incremental. We recommend enabling streaming for ~10-15% of requests (payments) only.
- Batching settings: payments route max_batch_size=8-16, timeout_ms=10-20; bulk support route batch_size=64-128 for cost efficiency.
- Fallback: automatic fallback to a slightly cheaper model variant if latency degrades; we can expose routing policy by tag so you only pay premium for routed tokens.

I've attached the price calc and included a tab with latency vs batch-size estimates. Happy to join the Thursday review - I'll bring perf numbers.
